quality.review_scope: Main-text colloidal nanocrystal synthesis and six nominal precursor-ratio variants independently quick-audited under MatterSyn workflow v5. Figures 1–6 and Table 1 are source-scoped; SI and downstream electrode-film/PEC synthesis are outside this review. This is literature evidence, not laboratory reproduction.
missing_fields: No paper-supplied individual metal-salt charge list; per-metal mmol are explicitly calculated from reported total and stoichiometric ratio.
Heating ramp rate, injection duration, stirring speed, growth-stage temperature trace, IPA volume, centrifuge force/speed, yield and storage unreported.
No measured sample-specific atomic coordinate asset; reference kesterite unit cell unavailable in current local registry.
For x=0.45/0.25, TEM length/diameter are graphical but not numerically tabulated; no digitized values assigned.
Main-text electrode/PEC sample preparation is downstream and not represented as a second colloidal synthesis.
Exact analyzed EDX composition differs from the nominal x-series formula; Figure 6 reports sulfur deficiency and composition deviation, not an exact formula for every product.
conflicts: Table 1 labels x=0.45 and x=0.25 kesterite while text notes very weak approximately 27° wurtzite features; retain both statements.
x=0.05 is a mixture of quaternary aggregates and approximately 3 nm ZnS; its 24.2 nm Scherrer value must not label every TEM particle.
